determination: hypothetical simulation compared with published counts; no field or real-world claim
corridor: SR-90 / Imperial Highway, Rose Drive to Yorba Linda Boulevard, Orange County, California

source.title: Yorba Linda Housing Element & General Plan Update Traffic Analysis, Appendix 4.1 Traffic Counts - March 2022 and Appendix 4.2 worksheets (EIR Appendix G)
source.preparedBy: Urban Crossroads, 2022-05-26; counts by Counts Unlimited, Inc.
source.terms: Public record on CEQAnet, no login. CEQAnet Conditions of Use (https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/Home/ConditionsOfUse) require permission from the owner for information not owned or created by the State. The count sheets are third-party work.
source.redistribution: not cleared: citation and fetch script only. No value from this study is stored in this repository.

scoring.countHour: Imperial Highway approach volume (left + through + right; the sheets' right-on-red column is a subset of right and is not added) in one clock hour, read where the edge ends: m{i}e at J{i+1} towards SR-91, m{i}w at J{i} towards Brea
scoring.neverScored: approach towards SR-91 at Rose Drive, approach towards Brea at Yorba Linda Boulevard, every cross-street approach; these may feed demand
scoring.stopRule: every seed at or above stopShare, or three steps with no gain in the mean share

spacingMetres.source: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), 'East Imperial Highway' carriageway towards SR-91, between junction nodes 122792378, 122761097, 122736957, 1355989938 and 122774980; read 2026-11-13

laneGroups.source: the cited study, Appendix 4.2 worksheets, 'Lanes' row per approach

lanesAlongLink.value: the stop-line lane count is kept over the whole link; a cross-street exit gets the through-capable lane count of the same leg's entering approach

speedMetresPerSecond.note: the stack's value; OpenStreetMap tags most of the section 50 mph, not applied

vehicleType.value: the stack's passenger car (accel 2.6, decel 4.5, sigma 0.5, length 5, minGap 2.5, maxSpeed 13.89)

signalPlan.value: netconvert fixed-time plan, 60 s cycle, 3 s yellow, 1 s all-red, offset 0

signalControlType.source: the cited study, Appendix 4.2, Synchro sheet '8: Kellog Dr. & SR 90 WB Ramps' (the Caltrans-operated signal on this route next to the section): 'Control Type: Actuated-Uncoordinated'. No timing sheet is published for the three modelled signals, so applying the type to them is an inference

actuatedTimings.value: the stack's gap-actuated plan: minimum green 8 s, maximum green 50 s

caltransPeakHourTwoWay.source: Caltrans Traffic Census, 2022 Traffic Volumes (count year 2021-10-01 to 2022-09-30), District 12, Route 090, ORA: postmile 7.271 ahead leg for the entry towards SR-91, postmile 11.147 back leg for the entry towards Brea. https://dot.ca.gov/-/media/dot-media/programs/traffic-operations/documents/census/2022/2022-traffic-volumes-ca-v2.xlsx ; same data on https://data.ca.gov/dataset/annual-average-daily-traffic under Creative Commons Attribution

directionalSplit.note: Caltrans publishes no K/D site on this route

peakHourUse.value: the Caltrans estimated peak hour is applied to each of the four counted hours

warmUpSeconds.note: uses the first counted interval's volume

unmodelledStreets.value: Los Angeles Street, Valley View Avenue (signal), Casa Loma Avenue, Eureka Avenue, Garden Place and driveways meet the section and are not modelled

steps.change: none: the stack's network, demand rates and fixed-time plan as they are, with the demand process sustained over the count windows
network: the synthetic 300 m single-lane geometry is replaced by the sourced spacing and stop-line lane groups of the five counted intersections
steps.source: parameters.spacingMetres (OpenStreetMap) and parameters.laneGroups (the cited study, Appendix 4.2)

steps.change: mainline entry demand: the stack's 600 and 300 veh/h give way to half of the Caltrans 2022 two-way peak-hour volume at each end
mainline entry demand: the Caltrans estimate gives way to the 15-minute volumes that left the two boundary intersections into the section on the count day
steps.source: the cited study, sheets 01_PLA_Rose_Imp and 05_YLA_Imp_Yorba; only movements of never-scored approaches and of cross streets at the two boundary intersections

steps.change: signal control type: the fixed-time plan gives way to the stack's own gap-actuated plan, with its timings unchanged
steps.source: parameters.signalControlType (control type only; parameters.actuatedTimings stay ASSUMED)

steps.change: turning shares: straight-only gives way to the 15-minute left/through/right shares of each modelled approach on the count day
steps.source: the cited study, sheets 02_YLA_Pros_Imp, 03_YLA_Imp_Bast and 04_YLA_Imp_Lem. These shares include those of scored approaches (their split, not their volume)

steps.change: cross-street entry demand: the stack's 120 veh/h per entry gives way to the 15-minute approach volumes of the six cross-street approaches on the count day
steps.source: the cited study, sheets 02_YLA_Pros_Imp, 03_YLA_Imp_Bast and 04_YLA_Imp_Lem; cross-street approaches are never scored
